Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Chalo, shuru karein?

Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Ise ek baar aise sochte hain. Sadak 0 se 1 kilometre, 7 barabar gaps mein kati hai. Ek khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh ek pakki jagah hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre. Doosri taraf wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona wahan pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?
director.card: Doosri taraf wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona wahan pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

Is sawaal ka jawab 1/6 kilometre par hai, kyunki doosri taraf sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla mark 0 se ek gap par, yaani 1/6 kilometre. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi, aap batao
Khilona 6 barabar gaps wali sadak par 0 se bas ek gap chala; '6 mein se 1 gap' ko ek number mein bolte hain 1/6 kilometre. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao

Koi baat nahi, isse aasaan shabd abhi mere paas nahi hain. Is par hum phir aayenge; tab tak pehle wala sawaal saath mein dekhte hain. Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/3 par

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 3 barabar gaps, pehla mark ek gap par: 1/3. Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab us par 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab line ki doosri taraf dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, sab ek-doosre se barabar door. Us taraf kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
director.card: Ab line ki doosri taraf dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, sab ek-doosre se barabar door. Us taraf kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: eight gaps

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Line ki doosri taraf wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Line ki doosri taraf wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1 by 10

Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain.

director.text: samajh nahi aaya

Ghar se chalna shuru karo aur har gap par ek gino: khambon ke beech wale bhi, aur dono siron wale bhi. Ghar se school tak 1 kilometre ke raaste par 3 khambe barabar doori par hain; woh raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara
Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, kuch aur hai. 3 khambe raaste ko 4 barabar gaps mein kaatte hain: ghar se pehle khambe tak ek gap, aur aakhri khambe se school tak bhi ek. Doori gaps se naapte hain, khambon se nahi: khamba bas ek jagah hai, aur ghar se pehle khambe tak ka chalna ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/4 km

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe lagta hai haan

batting

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Line ki ek taraf 4 barabar gaps hain, doosri taraf 12. Dono taraf ke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1 by 12

Sahi jawab. Dekho, 12 barabar gaps ka har gap 4 wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/12 wala pehla mark 0 ke sabse paas hai. Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: 0 ke baad pehla mark

Haan, sahi hai: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne. Yahan tak saaf hai?
thak gayi, bye
Thakaan ho toh aaram karna bilkul theek hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge.
